tool.name: HyphAeon List Models
tool.description: List available HyphAeon model variants from Hugging Face Hub
tool.help:
HyphAeon List Models =====================
Lists all model variants available for download from the HyphAeon Hugging Face Hub repository (datamonkey/hyphaeon).
**When to use this tool**
Run this first if you want to select a specific model variant (e.g., a pathogen-specific model) in another HyphAeon tool. The output lists each variant name and its description. Copy the variant name (e.g., ``general``, ``viral``) and paste it into the "Model variant" field of the tool you want to run.
New variants are discovered dynamically from Hugging Face — this tool will always show the current list, even if new variants were added after the Galaxy wrapper was last updated.
